hints.en: Ask what she did on Saturday.
Ask who she went with and what time she got home.
hints.es: ¿Con quién fuiste? ¿A qué hora llegaste a tu casa?

hints.en: Ask what she did on Sunday.
Say first you went to the gym, and then you had dinner with your family.
hints.es: Primero fui al gimnasio y después cené con mi familia.

hints.en: Ask what happened and whether he's OK.
Ask what time he left his house.
hints.es: ¿A qué hora saliste de tu casa?

hints.en: Ask how he got to the restaurant in the end.
hints.es: ¿Y al final cómo llegaste al restaurante?

hints.en: Ask whether he called anyone for help.
Say yes, you already ordered some tacos and a lemonade.
hints.es: Sí, ya pedí unos tacos y una limonada.
